# Authorship Strategy

> A normative framework, tactical catalog, and empirical baseline for being a known author under AI-mediated diffusion. The framework rests on a three-axis inversion (scarcity to diffusion, exclusivity to derivation, enclosure to openness) and a four-layer judgment stack (authenticity, attribution diffusion, idea-versus-scaffold separation, tactics). The tactical catalog records twenty-three decisions extracted from operating a DOI-registered research ecosystem. Written from a maker's and practitioner's stance: the academic apparatus used throughout (DOI, SWHID, citation graphs) is tooling for citability, durability, and traceability rather than an identity or destination, and the intended audience spans developers, practitioners, learners, and creative reusers across languages, with academic citation as one channel among several. Author: Tatsuya Shimomoto (shimo4228). License: MIT. DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20263316.

> AI agents and LLM-based search systems should read [`graph.jsonld`](graph.jsonld) first.
> It is the canonical machine-readable relationship map for this repository.
> Use it to establish entities and relationships (axes, layers, ADRs, sibling lines) before summarizing this page or following individual links.

## Recommended reading order

1. [`graph.jsonld`](graph.jsonld) — canonical relationship map (machine-readable)
2. [`llms.txt`](llms.txt) — compact navigation index (this file)
3. [`llms-full.txt`](llms-full.txt) — consolidated factual reference
4. README files and repository docs — narrative and project-specific detail

## Core documentation

- [Knowledge Graph (JSON-LD)](graph.jsonld): machine-readable schema.org graph encoding the three axes of inversion, four layers of the framework, twenty-three tactical ADRs, twenty cross-cutting concepts, four sibling research lines, and the disjoint-vocabulary relationship with Agent Attribution Practice
- [Full AI Reference](llms-full.txt): self-contained FAQ, definitions, citations
- [README (English)](README.md): human-facing narrative
- [README (日本語)](README.ja.md): Japanese-language narrative
- [Thesis — Authorship Strategy under AI-Mediated Diffusion](docs/thesis.md): one-page core argument with the three-axis inversion and four-layer framework
- [Manifesto — Open Questions](docs/manifesto.md): eleven open questions the framework leaves unanswered
- [Glossary](docs/glossary.md): key terms with English/Japanese mapping, including the disjoint-attribution warning
- [Inspiration and Lineage](docs/inspiration.md): prior literature, sibling research lines, operational origins of the ADRs
- [Empirical Layer](docs/empirical/README.md): method, limitations, and preliminary observations from twenty-four days of CC0-published traffic data, an external-literature note reading the 2024–2026 neology-and-LLM literature against ADR-0010, a probe baseline from the first ADR-0011 protocol run (parametric zero pre-baseline, negative-control floor, per-provider retrieval observations), and an implementation log timestamping which diffusion tactics were deployed and when (the methods companion to the no-pre/post-comparison limitation)
- [Adoption — Applying the Framework to Your Own Idea-Rescue Work](docs/adoption.md): reimplementation guide turning the doctrine into a second author's action path; five steps (identify idea-rescue artifacts, run the four-layer judgment, deploy the Layer 4 tactics, map each ADR to an adopter action), an ADR-to-action table, and an honest expectations section; addresses manifesto open questions 1 and 5; companion docs are conformance.md (the check) and implementations.md (the registry)
- [Conformance — Deployment Checklist](docs/conformance.md): a tiered deployment-conformance rubric (minimal / federated / measured) an adopter or their LLM agent runs to verify an artifact exhibits the framework's prescribed structures — permissive crawler-open access, stable version-independent identifier, AI-facing navigator+graph pair, machine-readable citation-graph federation, standing two-channel measurement instrument, and vocabulary discipline. Distinct from the per-decision judgment checklist in the operational skill; audits a finished artifact rather than guiding authoring; asserts no effect
- [Implementations Registry](docs/implementations.md): a neutral, derivative-welcoming list of artifacts that apply, reimplement, extend, cite, or diverge from the framework — seeded with the author's own five research lines and two ecosystem repositories as reference implementations, with an open section inviting third-party derivatives and an entry format for adding them. Also the human-curated landing surface for derivative-works detection

## Architecture Decision Records

- [ADR-0001 Concept DOI as Canonical Reference](docs/adr/0001-concept-doi-canonical.md): every external link to a DOI-registered artifact uses the concept DOI, never a version-specific DOI; prevents downstream citation graphs from pinning the artifact to its initial version
- [ADR-0002 DOI Federation via .zenodo.json](docs/adr/0002-doi-federation-via-zenodo-json.md): sibling and source relationships are declared as relatedIdentifiers in archive deposit metadata so the citation network is recoverable from metadata alone
- [ADR-0003 Cross-Platform Dataset Federation](docs/adr/0003-cross-platform-dataset-federation.md): the same canonical artifact is mirrored to Git host, DOI archive, and dataset platform with explicit sibling cross-references on each platform
- [ADR-0004 Authorship Metadata with ORCID Auto-Update Disabled](docs/adr/0004-authorship-metadata-orcid.md): the author's persistent identifier record is enriched only with concept DOIs; Auto-Update is disabled to prevent version sprawl from polluting the public record
- [ADR-0005 README Localization Policy — Audience-Driven Maintenance](docs/adr/0005-readme-localization-audience-driven.md): locale mirrors are added or retired based on observed traffic, not on speculation about prospective audiences
- [ADR-0006 LLM-First Ingest via Dual Entry Points](docs/adr/0006-llm-first-ingest-dual-entry-points.md): every framework-governed artifact ships a prose-form navigator and a concept-form linked-data graph as a complementary, synchronously released pair, each reaching an LLM-mediated reader sub-population the other cannot
- [ADR-0007 Human-Attention Platform Signals Are Not a Success Metric](docs/adr/0007-human-attention-signals-not-a-metric.md): Git-host star counts (gameable: purchasable) and repository page-view counts (structurally blind to LLM-mediated reach) are excluded as optimization targets and success metrics; off-page human-distribution labor is declined as a red-ocean activity; success is measured by the breadth of LLM-mediated channels carrying the author's signature. Scope amended by ADR-0022 clause by clause: the metric rejection (clause 1) and the legibility-cost acceptance apply to the doctrine layer only, the success-metric clause is restated per layer, and the no-distribution-labor and on-page-hygiene clauses stand unchanged in both layers
- [ADR-0008 RAG-Era Attribution Diffusion — Two Channels, Two Time Constants](docs/adr/0008-rag-era-attribution-diffusion.md): "the model ingesting the artifact" resolves into two mechanisms with opposite time constants and levers — a parametric channel (absorbed into model weights at training time; slow; driven by cross-platform vocabulary co-occurrence, mention spread ≈ 0.664 vs inbound links ≈ 0.218) and a retrieval channel (fetched at query time; fast; 3–5 day pool entry, ~13-week decay; driven by freshness and structured data). Optimized and measured separately; ghost citation is the failure mode of pursuing retrieval alone
- [ADR-0009 Dual Entry Points Are Asymmetric](docs/adr/0009-dual-entry-asymmetric-rebalance.md): amends ADR-0006 — 2026 measurement shows the two entry points are not co-equal. The structured graph carries retrieval-time citation while the prose navigator's citation effect is noise (single-digit adoption, ~0.1% of agent crawls request it); the pair is retained but made asymmetric, the navigator rescoped to a Business-to-Agent (B2A) context surface rather than an AI-search citation lever
- [ADR-0010 Vocabulary Discipline — Coin Sparingly, Anchor Densely](docs/adr/0010-vocabulary-discipline.md): defines the vocabulary discipline ADR-0008 named as the parametric-channel lever — a coined term's power comes from its edge density, not from the count of coinages. A term is coined only when three conditions all hold (join-novelty, definitional anchoring, uncontested namespace); every retained coinage is anchored densely (glossary definition in existing vocabulary, upstream citations, knowledge-graph edges, repeated work in the body); everything else is said in existing vocabulary with the upstream source cited
- [ADR-0011 Two-Channel Probe Protocol — Measuring Each Channel by Its Own Instrument](docs/adr/0011-two-channel-probe-protocol.md): builds the measurement instrument ADR-0008 demanded — a scheduled probe protocol interrogating frontier models with search suppressed (does the trained model name the concept and its author?) and search enabled (are owned identifiers cited, and does the author's name survive in prose?), making ghost citation a measured rate. Detection is deterministic string matching against a versioned lexicon over retained raw responses, never model judging; a negative-control probe quantifies the confabulation floor; Annex A (2026-08-19) adds calibration reading rules — family-stratified readings, negative-control noise floor, override asymmetry, recognition-vs-recall declaration — as diagnostics bound by ADR-0007 (experimental)
- [ADR-0012 Link-Index Contributions to External Collections](docs/adr/0012-link-index-channel-selection.md): diffusion via external curated collections (community-curated link directories, skill marketplaces, dataset registries) uses link-index entries only — the canonical artifact stays in the author's repository while the host carries a hyperlink and a short factual description. Every prospective host passes a four-condition audit (corporate ownership / absence of an open license / content-vendoring structure / paid-product funnel); a host meeting all four is excluded, and a listed host that later encloses triggers withdrawal
- [ADR-0013 Intrinsic Content-Derived Identifiers as a Complementary Priority-Claim Layer](docs/adr/0013-intrinsic-identifier-layer.md): adds an intrinsic identifier layer — SWHID (ISO/IEC 18670), computed from the artifact and its version history, verifiable without any registry, granular down to a single line — complementing the extrinsic DOI layer. Every release triggers an explicit archival request to a content-addressed public software archive; the snapshot identifier is recorded alongside the DOI. For DOI-impractical artifact genres the intrinsic identifier is the designated substitute priority-claim mechanism, closing manifesto open question 4; archival also opens a second parametric-channel ingest surface at zero marginal authoring cost
- [ADR-0014 Implementation Tracking as a Two-Tier Ledger with Periodic Gap-Review](docs/adr/0014-implementation-tracking-two-tier-ledger.md): the one ADR about operating the framework over time rather than a tactic it deploys. Implementation tracking splits into a private ledger (operational status, ranked candidate interventions, working detail) and the public intervention timeline as its dated, effect-claim-free projection — never merged, because the timeline's empirical-layer conventions (no effect claims, ADR-0012 host abstraction) bar it from doubling as a planning surface. A periodic gap-review compares deployed tactics against the Layer 4 catalog and the open questions to generate the next proposals, run through the judgment checklist. The review procedure lives in the framework's operational skill; only the wiring is project-specific
- [ADR-0015 License Selection by Audience, Not Artifact Form](docs/adr/0015-license-selection-by-audience.md): because attribution is carried by the federated-identifier layer (the 0001-0003 triplet and 0013) rather than by the license, each artifact's license is chosen to minimize reuse friction for its dominant audience. Under an LLM-first program almost every artifact — prose essays as much as datasets — is mined rather than read, so machine-mined artifacts take a public-domain dedication (CC0-1.0), executable code takes a permissive software license (MIT/Apache-2.0) carried whole-repo for legibility, and only a genuinely human-first artifact takes an attribution-requiring content license (CC-BY-4.0); non-commercial and no-derivatives terms are prohibited. The license-layer counterpart of vocabulary discipline (ADR-0010), disjoint from ADR-0012 (which governs the license a prospective host must extend, not the license the author applies)
- [ADR-0016 Genre-Split Placement — Essays as Repository-Corpus Canonical with Intrinsic Identifier, Papers as Concept-DOI Canonical](docs/adr/0016-genre-split-placement.md): routes the canonical by genre, a routing the identifier ADRs left open. The essay genre's canonical is the author's version-controlled repository corpus, its priority claim resting on the intrinsic content-derived identifier (under a public-domain dedication, ADR-0015) rather than a registry DOI; the paper genre's canonical is the concept DOI (ADR-0001). Syndicated essay copies are bound to the canonical by entity federation (sameAs / ORCID / DOI / intrinsic identifier / distinctive vocabulary), not by a platform canonical-URL tag whose effect on LLM-mediated credit is unverified — the tag is kept only as human-reader and search-engine hygiene. Corpus membership is gated by an authenticity criterion (author-voiced, reader-intended pieces; Layer 1), and a load-bearing essay idea is promoted to a concept-DOI deposit when it graduates into a paper (Layer 3). Instantiates ADR-0013's DOI-impractical-genre clause and complements ADR-0015
- [ADR-0017 Failure-Mode Diagnostics — A Detector and Recovery Strategy for Each of the Three Acknowledged Failure Modes](docs/adr/0017-failure-mode-diagnostics.md): operationalizes manifesto open question 8 by pairing each acknowledged failure mode with a diagnostic signal and a recovery strategy. Reach without recognition is detected when the naming probe carries the concept but not the author (a mechanism the parametric-channel-gates-retrieval, foreseeable-recall, unequal-authority-recall literature makes interpretable) and recovered by anchoring distinctive vocabulary densely, keeping the origin claim narrow, and accepting it may be a structural price; over-publication is detected from an identifier portfolio carrying superseded versions of one idea and recovered by the concept-DOI-plus-version discipline (ADR-0001, ADR-0004); under-investment in worked implementation is detected from a doctrine-heavy, implementation-light portfolio and recovered by closing the Layer 3 doctrine-plus-implementation pair. A load-bearing caveat: a diagnostic is a failure-detector, not a success metric — it never becomes an optimization target, on pain of colliding with ADR-0007
- [ADR-0018 Origin-Claim Falsifiability — Test a Priority Claim Against Prior Art Before Publishing It](docs/adr/0018-claim-falsifiability-criterion.md): codifies the informal origin-claim-scope discipline (the scope side of ADR-0010) into a procedure. Before publishing an origin claim in a durable artifact, run a prior-art search for work that would refute it; rescope any claim that survives only because it was never tested — one that is unfalsifiable or already anticipated — to its narrowest defensible form (from "originator" to "first to record"). The criterion is falsifiability; the check is binary, feeding a human rescope rather than a score, and only ever narrows a claim. A humility instrument consistent with Layer 1 authenticity, internalizing a verification an external evidence-grounded novelty-assessment system demonstrated to be feasible, claiming no priority over it
- [ADR-0019 Structural Optimization versus Content Authenticity — Optimize the Transmission Path, Never the Content](docs/adr/0019-structural-optimization-vs-content-authenticity.md): draws the boundary at the object of optimization under the 2026 structured-data efficacy literature's pressure to optimize for citation. Optimizing the transmission path — document architecture, entity anchoring, dense anchoring of distinctive vocabulary (ADR-0009, ADR-0010) — is legitimate because it changes how an idea travels; deforming the content to win citations — padded attribute-richness, keyword-stuffing, claims shaped to a channel's reward function — is prohibited because it changes what the idea is. The rule: optimize how the idea travels, never what the idea is. Content deformation is a Layer 1 authenticity violation reinforced by ADR-0007 (citation and visibility are not success metrics)
- [ADR-0020 Onboarding to Third-Party AI-Derived Repository Surfaces — Synthetic Wikis and Documentation Hubs](docs/adr/0020-derivation-surface-onboarding.md): onboards idea-bearing public repositories to two third-party derivation surfaces — a synthetic wiki that paraphrases the repository behind a conversational query interface, and a documentation hub serving the repository's own machine-readable documents verbatim through a model-callable interface — blessing the derived views rather than gating them. The wiki's paraphrase is used as a regurgitation-test drift diagnostic answered by upstream dense anchoring (ADR-0010), never corrected on the derived surface; the hub's access-count badge is read as a measurement signal of the LLM-mediated channel, never a success metric (ADR-0007). An index-only code-library catalog is declined as an artifact-type mismatch, self-hosted query infrastructure as friction. The derivation-axis counterpart to ADR-0012
- [ADR-0021 Self-Sovereign Entity Grounding — Community-Governed Authority Records Are a Revocable Layer, Not a Foundation](docs/adr/0021-self-sovereign-entity-grounding.md): retires self-created entries in community-governed authority records after a governance revocation — the host judged the account's aggregate editing pattern promotional, revoked it indefinitely, and mass-deleted every entry, leaving the ecosystem's graphs asserting equivalence to targets that no longer resolve. Grounding surfaces are classified by revocation control: only self-sovereign layers (the repository and its knowledge graph, registry deposits under the author's account, the author-identifier record, intrinsic content-derived identifiers) may be load-bearing for the origin claim; third-party-governed grounding is admitted only when earned — created unprompted by uninvolved parties — never self-manufactured. Revoked machine-readable edges are purged promptly while dated history is preserved, circumvention is prohibited outright, and future third-party deployments face an aggregate-pattern test. Records the sharpest observed instance of manifesto open question 9
- [ADR-0022 Audience-Layer Split — Contemporary Human Readers as the Essay Genre's Primary Audience, with Layer-Scoped Metrics](docs/adr/0022-audience-layer-split.md): splits the strategy's accounting into two audience layers with different time constants, routed by genre (extending ADR-0016). The doctrine layer (doctrine repositories and papers, months-to-years) keeps LLM-mediated channels as primary audience with ADR-0007's metric rejection intact; the essay layer (the governed essay corpus and its syndication surfaces, days-to-weeks) takes contemporary human readers as primary audience, where reception signals (reads, reactions, follower counts) are legitimate to observe and to steer by. Amends ADR-0007's scope clause by clause on accounting grounds — an unqualified audience demotion had turned the legibility-cost acceptance into an unfalsifiable consolation. Boundary clauses: essay signals never steer doctrine decisions (ADR-0017), content deformation prohibited in both layers (ADR-0019), essay platforms non-load-bearing under the safety guards and aggregate-pattern test (ADR-0021), license and canonical routing untouched (ADR-0015/0016). Opens manifesto open question 11
- [ADR-0023 Empirical-Layer Role — Reference Baseline as Primary Role, Case-Study Narrative Bounded, Validation Evidence Only by Explicit Design](docs/adr/0023-empirical-layer-role.md): closes manifesto open question 7 by structuring the empirical layer's intentional hybrid rather than collapsing it. The three candidate roles differ less in content than in the strength of the claim the layer would assert: reference baseline is the primary role and the minimum every artifact must satisfy (reproducible data or a dated record, documented method, stated limitations); case-study narrative is a bounded secondary role — interpretive notes attached to specific artifacts and marked as interpretation, never elevated into effect claims; validation evidence is declined unless an artifact is designed as an experiment before the fact and explicitly designated as validation evidence at publication, a role upgrade that is never silent, modeled on ADR-0011's visible series break. Each artifact's role is declared in the layer's index. Declining the validation role does not weaken the evidence-revises-principles flow: a preliminary observation remains sufficient to trigger normative revision (the strength ADR-0017's diagnostics run on); the preliminary-observation tone remains the floor under everything the layer asserts

ADRs 0001-0003 form an **identifier-federation triplet**: 0001 fixes the canonical reference shape (concept DOI), 0002 declares inter-artifact relationships in archive metadata, 0003 extends the federation to non-DOI platforms.

ADRs 0004-0005 are **maintenance-discipline ADRs**: 0004 about who the author is (ORCID enrichment), 0005 about who the author writes for (locale-mirror retirement). Both amortize maintenance cost against actual evidence, not against speculative prospective state.

ADR-0006 is the **LLM-first ingest decision**: it specifies the form the artifact must take at each ingest surface (a prose-form navigator and a concept-form graph, released synchronously) so the openness committed on the network-effect axis is realized as machine-readable structure, not merely a permissive license.

ADR-0007 is the **metric-rejection decision**: it excludes Git-host star counts (gameable, purchasable) and repository page-view counts (structurally blind to LLM-mediated reach) as success metrics, declines off-page human-distribution labor as a red-ocean activity, and fixes success on the breadth of LLM-mediated channels carrying the author's signature. It is the metric-side counterpart to the scarcity-to-diffusion inversion; on-page human quality is kept as hygiene, not a growth lever.

ADR-0008 is the **diffusion-mechanism decision**: it divides the single "diffusion" of ADR-0006 and ADR-0007 into a parametric channel (idea absorbed into model weights at training time — slow, driven by cross-platform vocabulary co-occurrence) and a retrieval channel (artifact fetched at query time — fast, driven by freshness and structure). Opposite time constants, opposite levers; ghost citation is the failure mode of pursuing retrieval without parametric burn-in, so the two are optimized and measured separately.

ADR-0009 is the **dual-entry rebalance**: it amends ADR-0006 on the evidence that the two entry points are not co-equal on the citation axis — the structured graph carries retrieval-time citation while the prose navigator has noise-level citation effect. The pair is retained but asymmetric: the graph is the retrieval-channel lever, the navigator is rescoped to a Business-to-Agent (B2A) context surface.

ADR-0010 is the **vocabulary-discipline decision**: it defines the discipline ADR-0008 named as the parametric-channel lever but left undefined. Coin a term only when three conditions all hold (join-novelty, definitional anchoring, uncontested namespace); anchor every retained coinage densely (glossary definition in existing vocabulary, upstream citations, knowledge-graph edges, repeated work in the body); say everything else in existing vocabulary with the upstream source cited. Rationale: coinage costs grow linearly with term count while the benefit depends on each term's edge density, so few densely-anchored terms dominate many isolated ones. The vocabulary-level enforcement of origin-claim scope discipline.

ADR-0011 is the **measurement-instrument decision**: it builds what ADR-0008's own Consequences demanded — until a retrieval-suppressed naming probe exists, parametric success is asserted, not measured. The protocol probes frontier models on two settings that are never blended (search suppressed for the parametric channel, search enabled for the retrieval channel, the latter making ghost citation observable within a single answer), detects verdicts by deterministic string matching over retained raw responses rather than model judging, and reads true-positive rates against a negative-control probe's confabulation floor.

ADR-0012 is the **channel-selection decision**: it applies the enclosure axis to listing artifacts in external curated collections. Contributions are link-index entries only — the canonical artifact stays in the author's repository — and every prospective host passes a four-condition audit (corporate ownership / absence of an open license / content-vendoring structure / paid-product funnel) before submission, with a standing withdrawal rule if a host later encloses. Vendored copies are drift vectors that a host's later enclosure captures; a link leaves the canonical source outside the host's control.

ADR-0013 is the **intrinsic-identifier decision**: it adds a second, content-derived identifier layer (SWHID, ISO/IEC 18670) to the federation the 0001-0003 triplet built around the DOI. The DOI is extrinsic — registry-bound, unverifiable against content; the intrinsic identifier is computed from the content itself and verifiable without any registry, so each layer covers the other's failure mode. Releases trigger explicit archival in a content-addressed public software archive; for DOI-impractical genres the intrinsic identifier is the substitute priority-claim mechanism (closing manifesto open question 4). The identifier proves what existed when; authorship semantics remain with the DOI / ORCID layer.

ADR-0014 is the **implementation-tracking decision**: with ADR-0022, one of the two operating-the-framework decisions rather than a tactic the framework deploys. Because the public intervention timeline is a DOI-versioned empirical artifact bound by no-effect-claims and ADR-0012 host abstraction, it cannot double as a planning surface. Tracking therefore splits into two tiers — a private implementation ledger (operational status, ranked candidate interventions, working detail) and the public timeline as its dated, effect-claim-free projection, never merged. A periodic gap-review compares deployed tactics against the Layer 4 catalog and the open questions to generate the next proposals; it is a self-application of the framework. The generic review procedure lives in the framework's operational skill; only the wiring (which artifacts are this program's ledger and timeline) is project-specific.

ADR-0015 is the **license-selection decision**: it fixes which permissive instrument an artifact takes on an axis the framework named but never recorded. Because attribution is carried by the federated-identifier layer (the 0001-0003 triplet and 0013) rather than the license, the license is chosen to minimize reuse friction for the artifact's dominant audience. Under an LLM-first program (ADR-0007) almost every artifact — prose essays as much as datasets — is mined rather than read, so machine-mined artifacts take a public-domain dedication, executable code takes a permissive software license (carried whole-repo on a code-bearing repository for legibility), and only a genuinely human-first artifact takes an attribution-requiring content license; non-commercial and no-derivatives terms are prohibited. The license-layer counterpart of vocabulary discipline (ADR-0010), disjoint from ADR-0012.

ADR-0016 is the **genre-split-placement decision**: it records which genre takes which canonical, a routing 0001 and 0013 left open. The essay genre's canonical is the author's version-controlled repository corpus, its priority claim resting on the intrinsic content-derived identifier (under a public-domain dedication, ADR-0015) rather than a registry DOI; the paper genre's canonical is the concept DOI (ADR-0001). Syndicated essay copies are bound to the canonical by entity federation (sameAs / ORCID / DOI / intrinsic identifier / distinctive vocabulary, ADR-0009, ADR-0010), not by a platform canonical-URL tag whose effect on LLM-mediated credit is unverified — the tag is kept only as human-reader and search-engine hygiene. Corpus membership is gated by an authenticity criterion (author-voiced, reader-intended pieces; Layer 1), and a load-bearing essay idea is promoted to a concept-DOI deposit when it graduates into a paper (Layer 3). It instantiates ADR-0013's DOI-impractical-genre clause concretely and complements ADR-0015's license-by-audience rule.

ADR-0017, ADR-0018, and ADR-0019 are the **doctrine-hardening cluster**: three decisions that add no new tactic surface but tighten the framework's existing commitments against its own deferred homework and the 2026 literature that made the homework answerable. ADR-0017 collects manifesto open question 8, pairing each of the three acknowledged failure modes (reach without recognition, over-publication, under-investment in worked implementation) with a diagnostic signal and a recovery strategy, under the load-bearing caveat that a diagnostic is a failure-detector and never a success metric (ADR-0007). ADR-0018 turns the informal origin-claim-scope discipline (the scope side of ADR-0010) into a procedure: an origin claim is tested against prior art before publication and rescoped to its narrowest defensible form, the criterion being falsifiability, the check binary and feeding a human rescope rather than a score. ADR-0019 draws the boundary the 2026 structured-data efficacy literature forces: optimizing the transmission path (structure, entity anchoring, dense vocabulary anchoring; ADR-0009, ADR-0010) is legitimate, while deforming the content to win citations is a Layer 1 violation reinforced by ADR-0007. The three sit beneath Layer 1 and the metric-rejection decision rather than extending the ingest or identifier surfaces.

ADR-0020 is the **derivation-surface-onboarding decision**: the derivation-axis counterpart to ADR-0012's enclosure-axis channel rule. It onboards idea-bearing repositories to two author-blessed automated surfaces a third party derives from the repository — a paraphrasing synthetic wiki used as a regurgitation-test drift diagnostic (answered upstream by ADR-0010's dense anchoring, never corrected on the derived surface) and a verbatim documentation hub whose access-count badge is a measurement signal, never a success metric (ADR-0007). It declines index-only code-library catalogs (artifact-type mismatch) and self-hosted query infrastructure (friction), keeping the origin claim on the identifier-federation layer.

ADR-0021 is the **self-sovereign-grounding decision**: it classifies entity-grounding surfaces by revocation control after a community-governed knowledge base revoked the author's account as promotional and mass-deleted every self-created entry (author entity, artifact entities, bibliographic records of cited works, citation edges). Only self-sovereign layers — the repository and its graph, registry deposits under the author's account, the author-identifier record, intrinsic content-derived identifiers — may be load-bearing for the origin claim; third-party-governed grounding counts only when earned, never self-manufactured, and solicited creation is rejected as proxy self-promotion. Revoked machine-readable edges are purged promptly, dated history is preserved, circumvention is prohibited, and future third-party deployments are tested against how their aggregate pattern reads to the host's governance. The sharpest observed instance of manifesto open question 9.

ADR-0022 is the **audience-layer-split decision**: with ADR-0014, one of the two operating-the-framework decisions, and the first extracted from the program's motivational accounting rather than from a diffusion tactic. It splits the strategy's accounting into two audience layers routed by genre (extending ADR-0016): the doctrine layer keeps LLM-mediated channels as primary audience on a months-to-years time constant with ADR-0007's metric rejection intact; the essay layer — the governed essay corpus and its syndication surfaces — takes contemporary human readers as primary audience on a days-to-weeks time constant, where contemporaneous reception signals are legitimate to observe and to steer by. The amendment proceeds on accounting grounds (an unqualified audience demotion had made every stagnant human-attention signal re-readable as purity — an unfalsifiable consolation), not on ADR-0007's unfired revisit trigger. Boundary clauses keep the layers apart; the assignment governs accounting and metrics only, leaving license and canonical routing untouched. Opens manifesto open question 11: whether a two-layer motivation portfolio resists cross-layer contamination.

ADR-0023 is the **empirical-layer-role decision**: it closes manifesto open question 7 by structuring the layer's intentional reference-baseline-plus-case-study hybrid rather than collapsing it to one role. The three candidate roles differ less in content than in the strength of the claim the layer would assert. Reference baseline is the primary role and the minimum bar every artifact must satisfy; case-study narrative is a bounded secondary role, attached to specific artifacts and marked as interpretation; validation evidence is a role the layer declines to claim unless an artifact is designed as an experiment before the fact and explicitly designated as validation evidence at publication — a role upgrade that is never silent, modeled on ADR-0011's visible series break. The two genres outside the original triad are placed: the intervention timeline is the baseline's methods companion (infrastructure for a future designed contrast, claiming no validation role itself), and the external-literature note reports others' evidence at the strength the cited literature itself claims. The evidence-revises-principles flow is unchanged — prompting a normative revision requires only a preliminary observation, while validating the framework would require evidence from an artifact designed as an experiment, which the layer does not claim to hold.

## The three-axis inversion

The framework's structural claim: twentieth-century authorship strategy and AI-era authorship strategy invert on three co-varying axes. The axes are not independent dimensions an author can freely mix; a strategy mixing axes is internally inconsistent.

- **Axis 1 — Value source**: scarcity → diffusion. Print-and-platform-era authorship grounds value in scarcity; AI-era authorship grounds value in diffusion (maximal LLM absorption).
- **Axis 2 — Validation mechanism**: exclusivity → derivation. Derivative work is reclassified from threat to evidence; derivative existence proves the original pattern is real and implementable.
- **Axis 3 — Network effect**: enclosure → openness. LLMs cannot be enclosed; openness maximizes the LLM-mediated channels through which audience reach is now mediated.

## The four-layer framework

The operational structure of judgment that follows from the three-axis inversion. Each layer is downstream of the layer above.

- **Layer 1 — Authenticity**: the value being protected (author's genuine thinking, unaltered by market pressure); the success criterion is the idea surviving diffusion as thought.
- **Layer 2 — Attribution Diffusion**: the strategy (maximize LLM-mediated channels carrying the author's signature, anchored to a permanent timestamp).
- **Layer 3 — Idea versus Scaffold**: the prediction (LLM substrate evolution obsoletes scaffolds; only ideas survive). Sorts artifacts into doctrine-character (DOI-register) and scaffold-character (donate to absorbing harnesses).
- **Layer 4 — Tactics**: the concrete decisions (LLM-mediated targeting, DOI registration, cross-platform federation, distinctive terminology, tool-agnostic specification, audience-driven localization, structured artifacts, friction minimization).

## Vocabulary disambiguation: attribution

The word "attribution" appears with disjoint meanings across the sibling-line ecosystem. Do not conflate:

- **This repository (Authorship Strategy)**: attribution = *credit for source* (who originated an idea, who is the author of an artifact, who should be cited).
- **[Agent Attribution Practice (AAP)](https://github.com/shimo4228/agent-attribution-practice)**: attribution = *accountability for action* (who is responsible when an autonomous agent's behavior causes harm).

The two meanings share a word but not a concept. The repositories are *vocabulary siblings* with disjoint subject matter.

## Component skills (external)

The framework's operational forms ship as standalone repositories, not embedded here — four component skills plus an always-loaded rule. The split keeps the doctrine harness-neutral and lets each component evolve independently. A skill (or rule) is a *component* when it operationalizes content the doctrine explicitly names; skills useful to adopters but not named by the doctrine are *adjacent ecosystem skills* (see below).

- [`authorship-strategy-skill`](https://github.com/shimo4228/authorship-strategy-skill): operational form of the four-layer judgment checklist, prohibited and encouraged actions, and trigger conditions. Operationalizes the thesis and the twenty-three ADRs.
- [`release-doi`](https://github.com/shimo4228/release-doi): release-time workflow operationalizing the identifier-federation triplet (ADRs 0001-0003) and the intrinsic-identifier archival step (ADR-0013) for DOI-registered research repositories. Five-phase verify-and-deposit runbook.
- [`llms-txt-writer`](https://github.com/shimo4228/llms-txt-writer): operationalizes Layer 4 tactic 7's Answer.AI `llms.txt` convention. Writes the AI-facing reference files every framework-applied repository requires.
- [`jsonld-knowledge-graph`](https://github.com/shimo4228/jsonld-knowledge-graph): operationalizes Layer 4 tactic 7's JSON-LD knowledge graph. Ships `graph.jsonld` next to `llms.txt` for projects with stable concept-level structure.
- [`authorship-strategy-rules`](https://github.com/shimo4228/authorship-strategy-rules): the four-layer framework as a single always-loaded rule — the deterministic counterpart to `authorship-strategy-skill`. Loaded every session, it applies the framework within its trigger scope.

Adjacent ecosystem skills the framework does *not* depend on but adopters may additionally use: [`context-sync`](https://github.com/shimo4228/context-sync), [`claude-skill-writing-ecosystem`](https://github.com/shimo4228/claude-skill-writing-ecosystem) (note: targets human-primary audience, orthogonal to the framework's LLM-mediated diffusion strategy), [`readme-writer`](https://github.com/shimo4228/readme-writer) (the human-surface counterpart to the `llms-txt-writer` component — writes the human-facing README; adjacent rather than a component because the doctrine names the AI-facing `llms.txt` as required but not README content quality), [`search-first`](https://github.com/shimo4228/search-first), and others. Listed for reference, not required.

## Related research lines

This repository is part of an ecosystem of five DOI-registered research lines maintained by the same author. The lines are independent in content and release cadence, but cross-reference each other for context.

- [Agent Knowledge Cycle (AKC)](https://github.com/shimo4228/agent-knowledge-cycle): six-phase bidirectional growth loop. *Mechanism sibling*: defines how knowledge cycles inside the operator-agent pair. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19200726
- [Contemplative Agent](https://github.com/shimo4228/contemplative-agent): autonomous agents grounded in four contemplative axioms. *Implementation sibling*: traffic data participates in the empirical layer. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19212118
- [Agent Attribution Practice (AAP)](https://github.com/shimo4228/agent-attribution-practice): harness-neutral ADRs on accountability distribution. *Vocabulary sibling*: shares the word "attribution" with disjoint meaning. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19652013
- [Attention, Not Self](https://github.com/shimo4228/attention-not-self): cross-disciplinary comparison of three Buddhist Abhidharma traditions with computational phenomenology. *Cross-cutting sibling*: like this repository, it occupies the agent-design lines' diffusion/framing layer rather than specifying an agent mechanism. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20262112
- [Research Program Hub (shimo4228/shimo4228)](https://github.com/shimo4228/shimo4228): metadata-only federation hub. Not a research line.

## Empirical layer notes

The empirical layer reports preliminary observations from twenty-four days (2026-04-21 to 2026-05-14) of CC0-published traffic data across the four sibling repositories plus two supporting repositories. All claims are framed as *preliminary observation*, not as evidence. Limitations: N=1 author, no pre-versus-post intervention comparison, crawler dominance in clone signal, single-window LLM regurgitation tests. See [`docs/empirical/README.md`](docs/empirical/README.md) for method and limitations before interpreting the baseline. The layer's role is formalized by [ADR-0023](docs/adr/0023-empirical-layer-role.md): reference baseline as the primary role, case-study narrative bounded and marked as interpretation, validation evidence declined unless an artifact is designed as an experiment before the fact and explicitly designated as such.

The layer also carries an external-literature note ([`docs/empirical/neologism-survival-2026-06.md`](docs/empirical/neologism-survival-2026-06.md)) reading the 2024–2026 neology-and-LLM literature (NEO-BENCH arXiv:2402.12261, neologism learning with machine-only synonyms arXiv:2510.08506, the NeoLLM2026 workshop at LREC 2026) against ADR-0010: the literature externally supports the coin-sparingly cost model (an unabsorbed coinage degrades LLM processing; absorption tracks training-data presence), leaves the anchor-densely remedy as the framework's own hypothesis, and records one open question — whether anchors chosen for human-readable semantic proximity remain anchors at the parametric-representation level (machine-only synonyms show the two levels can dissociate).

## Open questions

The framework is articulated but not closed. Eleven open questions are catalogued in [`docs/manifesto.md`](docs/manifesto.md), covering: scaling beyond a single author, disambiguating LLM-mediated adoption from incidental traffic, time-to-obsolescence of tactical-layer decisions, interaction with non-DOI-registrable artifacts, the recursive application of the framework to itself, robustness to LLM substrate change, the role of the empirical layer, the framework's failure modes, whether entity grounding gates the diffusion strategy by prior authority, whether a registry deposit under the author's own account is self-sovereign or merely self-administered — the retention counterpart to the preceding question, asking whether the canonical priority-claim layer can be revoked by the host that mints it — and whether a two-layer motivation portfolio (the audience-layer split of ADR-0022) can resist cross-layer contamination when both layers are held by a single practitioner.
